already_reset: To start over, remove {config} and the {data} folder on the server.
hint_php: Choose a newer PHP version in your hosting control panel.
hint_ext: Switch on the PHP extension {ext} in your hosting control panel.
hint_data: In your FTP program, set this folder's permissions to 775 and reload this page. Still not writable? Use 777.
hint_config: Make this folder writable in the same way as data/. After installing, 755 is enough again.
chk_gd: GD with JPEG (image versions made on the server)
hint_gd: Without GD the web interface makes the web and thumbnail versions in the browser.
hint_zip: Without it, upload the spreadsheet and the images separately.
hint_xlsx: Without them, save the spreadsheet as CSV UTF-8 and import that.
hint_curl: Switch on curl to fetch imports from a web address or a bucket.
hint_upload: Raise upload_max_filesize and post_max_size (public/.user.ini does this on most hosts).
s2_text: We wrote a code to {file} on your server. Open it with your FTP program or the file manager of your host. This proves you are the owner.
s2_wait: As soon as the data folder is writable (step 1), we write a code to {file}. Reload this page after changing the permissions.
db_sqlite: Simple: a database file in the data folder (fine for most brands)
db_mysql: MySQL / MariaDB from my hosting account
s5_text: Used for invitations and for "your download is ready". Leave it empty to copy invitation links yourself.
smtp_legend: SMTP server (optional; otherwise PHP mail() is used)
err_code: The setup code is not correct. Open {file} with your FTP program or file manager.
err_url: Enter the web address of the portal, for example https://brands.example.com.
err_mysql: Enter the MySQL host and database name from your hosting control panel.
err_from: The sender e-mail address is not valid.
err_config: {file} could not be written. Make the config folder writable and try again.
done_code: Your setup code is {code}. The setup wizard asks for it once.
done_bg_text: Imports, zip downloads and e-mails run in the background. Add one of these in your hosting control panel (cron jobs), every minute or every 5 minutes:
done_bg_or: or, if your host can only call a web address:
done_bg_url_only: On this hosting, use the web address: a cron job runs as your FTP account, which may not open the files the portal wrote. Most control panels let you enter it as a cron job with a URL, or with curl or wget.
done_bg_none: Without a cron job the portal still works: it catches up whenever someone uses it.
